sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजपुत्रस्य धीमतः।ते समारुरुहुर्हृष्टाः कुम्भकर्णं प्लवङ्गमाः ।। ६.६७.११९ ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rājaputrasya dhīmataḥ।te samāruruhurhṛṣṭāḥ kumbhakarṇaṁ plavaṅgamāḥ ।। 6.67.119 ।।

translations.english: As Rama hit in anger, at once fire mixed with flames shot forth from Kumbhakarna's mouth.
